question: What does the interview process look like?
answer: For engineering roles at Meridian: application review, a short structured phone screen, an HR video interview, and a technical round with the hiring manager. Most candidates complete the process in 2–3 weeks.

question: What if I'm serving a long notice period?
answer: We evaluate notice periods against the role's joining need. For urgent roles we expect joining within 30 days; notice buyout support is considered case by case and discussed at the offer stage.

question: Is this role remote?
answer: Most Meridian roles are hybrid — three days a week from the Bellandur office in Bengaluru. Fully remote arrangements are rare and stated explicitly on the job description.

question: How does background verification work?
answer: Background checks run through our BGV partner, SpringVerify, after an offer is accepted. They verify employment history and education against the documents and profile you submitted. Nothing is checked without your consent.

question: Why do you ask for my profile URL?
answer: You choose to share a profile URL when you apply, and consent to us comparing it with your resume. We only ever review what you submit — we never scrape or collect profile data ourselves.

question: What is the compensation for this role?
answer: Every role is posted with its compensation band on the job description. Where you land in the band depends on your experience and interview performance; the recruiter will discuss specifics before the offer stage.

question: How do I transfer my PF / UAN from my previous employer?
answer: Your UAN stays the same across employers. Log in to the EPFO member portal with your UAN, raise an 'Online Transfer Claim' selecting Meridian Technologies as the present employer, and verify with the OTP linked to your Aadhaar. HR attests the claim within 3 working days of it appearing on our side. If your previous employer hasn't approved it within 10 days, raise a ticket and we'll follow up formally.

question: What is the leave policy?
answer: Per calendar year: 12 casual, 12 sick and 15 earned leave days. Casual and sick leave lapse at year end; up to 10 earned-leave days carry forward. Apply from My Space → My leave — working days are calculated against the holiday calendar automatically, and your manager/HR approve in the app.

question: Where do I find my payslips?
answer: My Space → My payslips lists every month since you joined. Open any row for the printable view. Payslips are generated by the payroll system and distributed here — if a month is missing or looks wrong, raise a ticket and HR will regenerate it.

question: How does probation work?
answer: Probation runs 90 days with structured check-ins at day 7, 30, 60 and 90. The day-60 and day-90 checkpoints include a manager evaluation. On successful completion you receive a confirmation letter in My Space → My letters. Check-ins are conversations about support and expectations — not exams.

question: Whom do I contact under the POSH policy?
answer: Meridian has an Internal Committee under the POSH Act. The presiding officer is Farida Ansari (Operations Manager) — reachable at ic@meridiantech.in, and complaints can be raised directly, confidentially, without going through your manager. The full policy and committee membership are in your induction kit.

question: What is my notice period if I resign?
answer: Notice is 30 days during probation and 60 days after confirmation, per your appointment letter. Notice-period recovery and leave adjustment follow the exit policy; HR walks you through the full-and-final process once a resignation is submitted.

question: Where is the holiday list?
answer: The 2026 holiday calendar (national + Karnataka) is in the Calendar section and My Space. Leave applications automatically exclude holidays from working-day counts.

question: How do I add dependents to health insurance?
answer: Dependents can be added within 30 days of joining, within 30 days of a life event (marriage, birth), or during the mid-year enrollment window. Submit details from My Space → Profile; e-cards arrive within 10 working days of the window closing.

question: I lost my ID card — what do I do?
answer: Raise a ticket immediately so the old card is deactivated. A replacement is issued in 2 working days; reception can give you a temporary day badge in the meantime. The first replacement in a year is free.

question: How do reimbursements work?
answer: Business expenses are claimed through the finance tool with bills attached, within 30 days of the spend. Approved claims pay out with the next payroll run. For client travel, use the travel desk for bookings instead of claiming afterwards where possible.

question: Is there a referral bonus?
answer: Yes — ₹50,000 for engineering roles and ₹25,000 for other roles, paid after the referred candidate completes 90 days. Submit referrals to the recruiting team with the role name; your referral is tracked on the requisition.

question: What does my onboarding buddy do?
answer: Your buddy is a peer (not your manager) who helps you find your feet in the first month — codebase or process walk-throughs, introductions, and the questions you don't want to ask in a big channel. They're assigned before day 1 and listed on your onboarding plan.

question: How do I get IT support or hardware upgrades?
answer: Raise a ticket describing the issue or request. Standard requests (peripherals, software licenses) resolve within 2 working days; hardware upgrades need manager sign-off and are fulfilled within a week when approved.

question: How do I change my salary bank account?
answer: Submit a cancelled cheque or bank letter for the new account via a ticket before the 20th of the month for it to apply to that month's payroll. Changes after the 20th take effect the following month.

question: How do I update my address on record?
answer: Update it from My Space → Profile and attach a supporting document (Aadhaar with the new address, rental agreement, or utility bill). The change reflects in HR records within 2 working days; request an address-proof letter from My letters if you need one issued.

question: Is the phone screen recorded?
answer: Yes — the structured phone screen is recorded and transcribed, and you're informed at the start of the call. The transcript is reviewed by a human recruiter; every advance/reject decision is made by a person, not the system.
